title: v2 ingest can drop the note FIELD entirely, leaving only a legacy.raw stub -- and a length delta reports the stub as a surviving short statement
body:
**Reported upstream by conflab-vc on hv's explicit instruction; full evidence in Conflab issue `0011` (HIGH). One of four filed separately: `0124`, `0125`, `0126` (this), `0127`.**

**MEASURED ON CONFLAB:** ST0121/AT-02.5 comes out of the ingest with `has_note: false` -- **no note field at all**, only a `legacy.raw` stub. A length-delta instrument reads its 434 -> 93 as a surviving short statement. **There is no statement.** The row does not carry a truncated note; it carries none.

That distinction is the whole finding. `0124` is a row that lost part of its prose and still reads complete. This is a row that lost the FIELD, and any instrument that measures "how much text survived" reports a number for it as though something did.

**A CORRECTION CARRIED FORWARD FROM THE REPORTERS, because it would otherwise be repeated into the fix:** conflab-ic first characterised this stub as *"an elided fragment opening on an ellipsis"*. **It is not.** `...::` is AUTHORED SHORTHAND for an elided path prefix, with 7 occurrences across the authored v2 files including AT-02.2, AT-02.3 and AT-02.4. **The ellipsis is the author's own and is not evidence of anything.** The defect is the absent note field. Do not chase the ellipsis.

**NOT CLAIMED:** this class has not been swept either. One instance, found while reading for something else.
